architecture_comparison.comparison_note: Microworld is designed for abstention and auditability; GPT-2 is designed for open-ended language modeling.
architecture_comparison.gpt2: Large pretrained transformer that samples next tokens from neural weights and does not expose a native selected-sense or audit decision.
architecture_comparison.microworld: Small explicit state machine with inspectable evidence, thresholds, anti-cues, guards, and audit/suppress decisions.

benchmark_scope.scope_note: This compares explicit audit-aware continuation with GPT-2 next-token generation on the v1 prompt set.

gpt2_baseline_architecture.summary: GPT-2 base model inference through local nanoGPT; no training or fine-tuning performed here.

headline.risk_coverage_tradeoff: The result exposes a risk/coverage tradeoff between explicit policy continuation and open-ended next-token generation.
headline.summary: Microworld emits fewer continuations but had zero measured wrong continuations among emitted rows in this benchmark; GPT-2 produced more usable continuations overall but also bad/unclear continuations and has no native audit path.

limitations: This is a small 120-row controlled continuation benchmark.
GPT-2 is an old base model, not ChatGPT or an instruction-tuned model.
GPT-2 has no native audit path; labels were audited after generation.
Microworld has low coverage and template-based realization.

rss_caveats: RSS is measured with resource.ru_maxrss inside subprocesses and is approximate.
macOS reports ru_maxrss in bytes; Linux reports kilobytes.
PyTorch and MPS memory behavior can make GPT-2 RSS noisy and environment-dependent.
GPT-2 RSS includes model loading overhead for the subprocess.

microworld_architecture.summary: Explicit sense memory, deterministic cue scoring, anti-cues/guards, conservative policy, template realization, and surface-risk audit gate.

non_claims: No claim that Microworld beats neural networks generally.
No claim that this small benchmark predicts open-domain generation quality.
No claim that GPT-2 represents modern instruction-tuned assistants.
